meta.notes: address level (ADRESSE.csv) only, so no Stiege or building sub-addresses; Grundstücksnummer pseudo-addresses (GNRADRESSE=1, 'GNR ...') dropped; id ADRCD; house_number HNR_ADR_ZUSAMMEN as written; road STRASSENNAME plus STRASSENNAMENZUSATZ where SZUSADRBEST says the suffix is part of the name; city is the postal Zustellort of the street, postcode PLZ; no state, as the register has no region name; no point marked estimated, as every BESTIMMUNGSART places the point on the address's own parcel; MGI / Austria GK West, Central and East (EPSG:31254, 31255, 31256, per row) transformed to EPSG:4326 with pyproj
meta.draw: lowest sha256('2026:' || register id) among eligible rows

forms.messy: same, without postcode, region and country, abbreviated by OpenCage's lists

meta.truth: the register's point, converted to WGS84 by PROJ where the register uses another CRS

operations.EPSG:31254: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of Austria Gauss-Kruger West + MGI to WGS 84 (3) + axis order change (2D)
operations.EPSG:31255: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of Austria Gauss-Kruger Central + MGI to WGS 84 (3) + axis order change (2D)
operations.EPSG:31256: axis order change (2D) + Inverse of Austria Gauss-Kruger East + MGI to WGS 84 (3) + axis order change (2D)
